notes.title: Intersolar Overdrive launches November 22nd
notes.content:
Very excited to make public a pre-release version of Intersolar Overdrive. 

The application is in it's final test cycle!  Working on setting up a gamepad controller that will default to the xbox 360 controller and can handle a custom set of button config for older controllers as well.

Going to develop a backlog of features.  All ideas are welcome.
